title: Extract invoice fields from a supplier email into JSON
notes: Expected values read twice from email.txt: total 4,675.00 (not the 4,250.00 subtotal), tax 425.00, issue 3 March 2027, due 2 April 2027 (net 30), no payment received -> unpaid. The check compares strings after trimming, the supplier name case-insensitively, and numbers within 0.005.
